Please draw my OCs Naoki and Takeshi.
Naoki is quiet, tsundere type. 168cm. Skinny body.
Please give Naoki leopard tail and ears. He has white spotting on his chest.
https://x.com/marimananari/status/1774269886900105587
Takeshi is rowdy, confident and fit. He is a delinquent boy. Please give him a jackal tail and ears. 186cm.
Please include Takeshi has white lines and black dots under his eyes. He has 八重歯.
They are a couple
Anything is okay!
I'll list some ideas:
0) They are in a band together. Draw them with guitars or microphone.
1) At the beach together. Naoki has a pool float ring. Takeshi has a surfboard.
2) They play arcade or crane games
3) They travel or go to sight seeing places; 奈良公園, 伏見稲荷大社, 沖縄, etc. Or 海外旅行! Anywhere is OK. 
4) Get married
5) Cute selfie
7) Matching couples outfits
8) Go to baseball game, aquarium or zoo.
9) スイカ割りor any summertime fun
10) 初詣 or 正月
11) Winter time
12) 北海道 trip
13) Naoki's birthday
14) Summer festival. Can wear yukata or jinbei.
15) Have icecream or kakigori or watermelon together. Summer break time.
16) Anything romantic; cuddling together, Takeshi picking up Naoki, kissing, holding each other, anything.
17) Naoki sits on Takeshi's lap on a sofa. Takeshi is posed in a cool manner. Naoki is posed like a hostess on a gambler's lap.
18) Drinks and food at izakaya or restaurant

These are only ideas; anything is okay!

Hello! I would love to request one of your cute chibi of my character Jack!

You are free to simplify his outfit however you want or even dress him differently. He is a scoundrel. Please note his long pointed ears, horns, freckles and maybe fangs? Thank you for your consideration!

Here are some reference arts of my Jack:

Heya! I happened to see your reddit post so I wanted to help you out! So for this I added more money since I would like 3 characters if that's fine.

I'm not sure if you'd like to do poses or not so if want to do your default pose thats completely fine! I will put what I had in mind just in case youd like to try it out. If you do default pose, the expression I describe will be enough will be enough. 

Macaroon: She's a dwarf that is typically always angry, annoyed and bothered but she also has a soft side to her. Her eyes are ALWAYS hallow and dead, she has bags under her eyes, a mole under her mouth and the floating cog wheels behind her. If you're able, I just like her to be crossing her arms with an annoyed facial expression. 

Alaric: He is a human Bard who likes to spread his music around the world. He is very theatric and may come across as annoying sometimes. His design isn't quite finished yet but the reference will have the colors needed, for him anything goes. As for the pose/expression it can be a replica of the reference I'm sending. Nothing too crazy there.

Nia: She's a human who is very good with a blade. She is also from the country side so she can come off as clueless and dumb but she's very bright and energetic. I'd like her to be winking with a smile and holding her blade. ALSO in the reference she has an alternate left eye color, please use that thanks!

Here are their references

Macaroon: https://imgur.com/a/vPZt2HL
Alaric: https://imgur.com/a/8XF6361
Nia: https://imgur.com/a/QMlSgMS

Thanks for reading and I'm looking forward to it!

Hello! Could you please draw my character Madison? 

Thank you! 

Reference: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GOiCZt_WcAAFEb8?format=jpg&name=large

Hello, sensei! Could I request a drawing of my ghost girl oc?

Her name is Ibis, and she’s been a ghost for so long, she doesn’t really remember if that’s her name or not. She lives in an abandoned mansion on the outskirts of a snowy mountain village, but isn’t the original habitant- she just moved in one day! She’s very playful, and likes to play games with a local village girl who doesn’t fear her. She also likes to collect cute things, and her favorite 'cutest' thing is a plush rabbit that the village girl gave her, which coincidentally happens to resemble her.

Themes: lace, ribbons, antiques, teddy bears and plush bunnies, ribbons, 'cuteness', snow

Thank you very much!

https://toyhou.se/27164029.ibis/gallery

Will you make something of my bat, succubus OC, Risa? Any floating pose would be perfect with a mischievous, crazy laughing or mocking expression, but anything is okay!

Please pay attention to her wings. They have pink ribbing and edges. Tricolored inside wings with white spots.
Please pay attention to the spots inside and outside of her ears, by her eyes, on her neck and shoulder and on her body. She has a tattoo marking on her stomach.
She is mischievous, crazy and a sexual character.
A floating or levitating sort of pose would be good for her.
She can be laughing crazily while holding her face, mocking, making a sneer, flirting, looking mischievous; I trust the pose and expression to you! She loves to drink alcohol.
She wears chokers, and heeled shoes or boots always.
Please don't make the outfit entirely white or black. She wears bright, contrasting colors. I trust you to design the outfit, so that you'll have more fun drawing it!
